title: Italy Torn Between Fiscal Ambition and Economic Fragility · 01 Sep
keywords: Italy, Matteo Salvini, Italian budget 2027, deficit, fiscal policy, ISTAT, consumer confidence, business confidence, inflation, eurozone, European Commission, coalition politics, public debt, economic outlook
notes: Italy's Deputy Prime Minister Matteo Salvini is pressing for at least 20 billion euros in additional deficit space for the 2027 budget, setting up a sharp conflict within the governing coalition and with European fiscal watchdogs. The push comes at a moment when official data paint a complex picture: consumer and business confidence ticked upward in August 2026, yet inflation remains above two percent and underlying growth stays weak. The gap between political messaging and economic reality is widening, and markets are watching closely.
